status_update_draft: This week I moved the novel-to-drama platform from generation experiments toward a production-ready, source-grounded pipeline. The main work was tightening source packet boundaries, adding traceable quality repair gates, hardening async jobs/retry/export flows, preparing ops readiness, and switching default generation to Doubao. The branch has 27 commits across 6 active days with 24 test files touched and about 8.4k lines of test additions. Remaining cleanup is the homepage/marketing pass plus review artifacts before packaging the branch for review.
